company.name: Crescent HVAC & Plumbing
company.description: Residential and light commercial HVAC and plumbing service, repair, and replacement across the Charlotte metro. Roughly 45% of revenue comes from recurring maintenance agreements with 6,800 members.

deal.details: Acquiring a retiring competitor in Rock Hill, SC ($1.1M EBITDA) for $5.0M. Seller has agreed to a 10% seller note; seeking senior debt to fund the balance and refinance our existing term loan.

company.name: Brightpath Home Health
company.description: Medicare-certified home health agency providing skilled nursing visits, physical therapy, and personal home care to seniors in metro Atlanta. Caregivers serve about 620 active patients.

deal.details: Opening a second branch in Macon and funding working capital for the first 9 months of payroll before reimbursements ramp.

company.name: Keystone Precision Machining
company.description: CNC machining and precision components for aerospace and industrial OEMs. 5-axis machine shop with AS9100 certification; founder is retiring with no succession plan.

deal.details: Signed LOI to acquire 100% of the company at $11.5M (5.3x). Equity from search investors and a 15% seller note; senior debt for the remainder.

notes.author: Jasmine (MAPlab)
notes.text: QoE kicked off with seller's accountant. Top customer is a Tier 1 aerospace supplier, 12-year relationship.

company.name: Northline Logistics
company.description: Asset-light freight brokerage and third-party logistics (3PL) provider serving food and beverage shippers in the Midwest. Manages about 1,900 loads per month through a carrier network of 4,000 trucking companies.

deal.details: Partial recapitalization to buy out a passive co-founder and refinance a $3M line of credit.

company.name: Verde Commercial Landscaping
company.description: Commercial landscaping and grounds maintenance for HOAs, office parks, and municipal contracts in the Houston area. 92% of revenue is under annual maintenance contracts.

deal.details: Replace aging mower fleet and add 12 crew trucks to service two new municipal contracts starting in January.

company.name: Sankofa IT Solutions
company.description: Managed services (MSP) and cybersecurity provider for federal contractors and nonprofits. Holds 8(a) certification and two GSA schedules; 70% of revenue is recurring monthly contracts.

deal.details: Growth equity to build a SOC-as-a-service offering and hire a business development team to pursue larger federal primes.

notes.author: Ray (MAPlab)
notes.text: Strong growth story. Need detail on the 31% customer: subcontract under a federal prime, recompete is Q3 2027.

company.name: Harbor Street Bakery Co.
company.description: Wholesale commercial bakery producing bread, rolls, and pastries for grocery chains, hospitals, and restaurants in the Mid-Atlantic. Runs two production shifts out of a 40,000 sq ft facility.

deal.details: Refinance a high-rate equipment loan and merchant cash advance taken during 2024 flour cost spike; lower debt service by roughly $300K per year.

company.name: Little Scholars Learning Centers
company.description: Operator of four licensed child care and early learning centers serving 410 children from infants through pre-K. Three-star state quality rating at all sites.

deal.details: Build out a fifth center in Southaven, MS on a leased site; waitlist of 160 families across existing locations.

company.name: Summit Facility Services
company.description: Commercial janitorial and facility services for Class A office, healthcare, and education clients across Dallas-Fort Worth. Multi-year contracts with 140 client sites.

deal.details: Founder seeking majority recapitalization and succession partner; wants to roll 30% and stay on the board.

notes.author: Jasmine (MAPlab)
notes.text: Founder is 64. COO (12 yrs tenure) would step into CEO role. Clean books, reviewed financials.

company.name: Ridgeview Auto Collision
company.description: Single-location collision repair and auto body shop. Most work comes through an insurer direct repair program (DRP).

deal.details: Cover a cash shortfall after a slow first half and catch up on vendor payables.

notes.author: Ray (MAPlab)
notes.text: Declined: leverage would exceed 7x and DRP dependence is high. Suggested they revisit after 2 profitable quarters.
